audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Individual positive-coset trace is replaced incorrectly by its sign pair; Spurious exterior character in the first twisted theta splitting identity; Ordinary versus narrow class number in real quadratic L-value evaluation
limitations: Counterevidence: For2mu=0 the formula is correct. Relevant coefficient symmetry makes corrected fully summed Theorem4.12 expression equal the printed one; main total-trace algebraicity not refuted.

Counterevidence: Second5.15 genuinely twists the outer trace and is not refuted. No separately admissible weakly holomorphic-input counterexample to5.20 constructed; weak rational-pi algebraicity not disproved.
Counterevidence: Narrow class number h+12=2 makes the formula correct. Theorem3.6 keeps L exactly; p57 correctly useslog(7+2sqrt12). The main rational logarithmic span and that example survive.
Limits: No full independent re-proof of imported Siegel-Weil, harmonic-Maass existence, rationality, Snitz or historical Sage calculations.
Limits: No author-code execution. Native auxiliary calculations are independently written standard-library arithmetic.
Limits: No equivalence to the52-page arXiv v1 or inaccessible publisher version is asserted.

Limits: The P1 component failure does not refute the symmetric Theorem4.12; P2 does not independently refute5.20 under an admissible weakly holomorphic input or the weaker rational-pi result; P3 remains conditional onordinary class number.

proposition.claim:
A component Poincare theta lift equals a constant times2 tr_(m,mu), despite its two-sided vector sum.

An untwisted outer primitive trace of an already twisted theta kernel contains an exterior chi_D(X0).

h(Delta) described as field class number, epsilon minimal totally positive unit, formulaL=h log(epsilon)/sqrtDelta. Wordordinary is not printed and interpretation is explicitly qualified.
